title: Spoken Turkish
summary: Understand Turkish as it is spoken and texted: `-(I)yor` without its r (*geliyo*, *napıyosun*), the shortened future (*gelicem*, *yapcaz*), *bi*, *n'aber* and *baya*, informal words such as *kanka* and *harbiden*, and texting abbreviations; then decide when to write it that way and when not to.
canDo: Understand spoken forms of the present continuous and the future, and use them with friends
Recognize the common reductions of everyday speech: bi, n'aber, di mi, baya
Use informal words and texting abbreviations with the right people, and only with them
Turn a casual message into standard written Turkish, and back
